deploybot: PROD deploy kickoff · service=runtime · env=prod · user=@michael · tag=release-2026-03-20 · window=2026-03-20T22:00Z-23:00Z · commits=3
    commits:
    - ab12cd3 (michael) https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/ab12cd3 — fixes KV cache ordering (PR #412)
    - f9e4b77 (sophia) https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/f9e4b77 — kernel selection fallback (PR #418)
    - 3c7a901 (carol) https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/3c7a901 — batching heuristic tweak (PR #421)

michael: heads-up — that f9e4b77 change caused a flaky unit test in staging earlier today, flakiness on vseq tests. Not failing in CI consistently though. :thinking:
sophia: hmm yeah I saw one flaky in CI, but it passed re-run. The change reduces replay cost but touches kernel selection path.
carol: do we need to pin anything before full rollout? want to avoid hitting prod with an unseen corner case during peak window.
deploybot: canary plan created: canary=10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> full. auto-rollback=on if error_rate>3% OR latency_p50_increase>150ms. links: canary config https://deploy.redwood.ai/canaries/1938765432
michael: i'd like to request pinning PR #421 (batching tweak) out of the prod bundle for this rollout. That was the least exercised in staging.
sophia: pinning PR #421 means deploying SHAs: ab12cd3 + f9e4b77 (no carol's). But carol's change is the batching tweak (3c7a901) — you mean pin out (exclude) or pin to previous (rollback to previous SHA)?
michael: exclude 3c7a901 from prod. keep ab12cd3 and f9e4b77. sorry for the unclear wording.
carol: if we exclude 3c7a901 we should run a quick perf smoke locally — that tweak was targeted at reducing small-batch latency. If excluded, some tail latency might regress. I'll validate within 10m.
infra-oncall: note: excluding batching tweak may increase memory pressure slightly at high concurrency. Our TPU/GPU queues have cushion but call it out in the runbook.
sophia: ok to proceed with canary that excludes 3c7a901. I'll create a pinned manifest:
```
# command to create pin
deployctl manifest create --service runtime --tag release-2026-03-20 --include ab12cd3,f9e4b77 --exclude 3c7a901
# apply to canary
deployctl apply --manifest manifest-1938765432.yaml --env prod --strategy canary
```
michael: runbook note: rollback SHA=prev-stable 9f8e7d6 (linked) if errors > threshold. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/9f8e7d6
carol: smoke results: small-batch latency +4ms p95, memory +1.2% at our load gen. No visible regressions. :white_check_mark:
infra-oncall: capacity check OK for canary. autoscaler headroom ~20% during window.
deploybot: Canary started · canary_id=cb-1938765432 · targets=10% of prod · applied manifest manifest-1938765432.yaml · commits_in_canary=[ab12cd3,f9e4b77]
michael: :eyes: watching logs for errors and p50/p95
sophia: enabling extra tracing for kernel selection for 30m. link to trace stream: https://observability.redwood.ai/streams/1938765432

carol: agree — no regressions seen in our smoke checks. go to 50% when ready.
sophia: promoting to 50% now.
